# RAG systems

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every system runs on the same dataset and is configured in the `systems:` list of an experiment file (see [configuration.md](configuration.md)). Each system accepts `chunker:`, `retrieval:`, `models:` and, where noted, `llm_features:` sections; unknown options are rejected when the config is loaded.

Profiles are relative: **cost** `low` = one generation call plus embeddings, `medium` = one extra short LLM call, `high` = several LLM calls per question or LLM work at ingestion; **latency** `fast` = no LLM call besides generation. *LLM in retrieval* means the retrieval side itself calls an LLM.

## Overview

| Type | System | Cost | Latency | LLM in retrieval | Agentic | Best for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`bm25`](#bm25) | BM25 | low | fast | no | no | Cheap baseline and exact-term matching |
| [`hybrid`](#hybrid) | Hybrid (BM25 + vector) | low | fast | no | no | Balanced lexical + semantic retrieval |
| [`hybrid_rerank`](#hybrid_rerank) | Hybrid + rerank | low | fast | no | no | Recall of hybrid plus rerank precision |
| [`parent_doc`](#parent_doc) | Parent document | low | fast | no | no | Better answer context with precise retrieval |
| [`rerank`](#rerank) | Vector + rerank | low | fast | no | no | Higher precision context selection |
| [`vector`](#vector) | Vector | low | fast | no | no | Semantic baseline |
| [`hyde`](#hyde) | HyDE | medium | medium | yes | no | Short or vaguely-worded questions |
| [`llm_heavy`](#llm_heavy) | LLM-heavy | high | slow | yes | no | Higher-cost, quality-oriented experiments |

## Chunker options

All systems except `parent_doc` use this `chunker:` section:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `str` | `token` | Chunker name: `token`/`word`, `fixed_char`, or `markdown`. |
| `chunk_size` | `int` | unset | Chunk size: words for `token`/`markdown`, characters for `fixed_char`. Default: 500 (`token`, `markdown`) or 1200 (`fixed_char`). |
| `chunk_overlap` | `int` | unset | Overlap between consecutive chunks, same unit as `chunk_size`. Default: 80 (`token`, `markdown`) or 150 (`fixed_char`). |

## `bm25`

**BM25.** Lexical BM25 over chunks.

Best for: Cheap baseline and exact-term matching. Cost: low; latency: fast.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |

## `hybrid`

**Hybrid (BM25 + vector).** BM25 + vector search fused with (optionally weighted) Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

Best for: Balanced lexical + semantic retrieval. Cost: low; latency: fast.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multi_query` | `bool` | `false` | Retrieve with local (non-LLM) query variants to help multi-hop questions. |
| `max_query_variants` | `int` | `4` | Maximum number of query variants when `multi_query` is on. |
| `rrf_k` | `int` | `60` | Reciprocal Rank Fusion smoothing constant. |
| `final_top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Alias for `final_top_k`; `final_top_k` wins when both are set. |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |
| `bm25_top_k` | `int` | `20` | BM25 candidates per query (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `vector_top_k` | `int` | `20` | Vector candidates per query (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `bm25_weight` | `float` | `1.0` | Weight of the BM25 ranking in weighted RRF; raise it to favor lexical evidence. |
| `vector_weight` | `float` | `1.0` | Weight of the vector ranking in weighted RRF; raise it to favor semantic evidence. |

## `hybrid_rerank`

**Hybrid + rerank.** Hybrid BM25 + vector RRF retrieval followed by a reranking pass.

Best for: Recall of hybrid plus rerank precision. Cost: low; latency: fast.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multi_query` | `bool` | `false` | Retrieve with local (non-LLM) query variants to help multi-hop questions. |
| `max_query_variants` | `int` | `4` | Maximum number of query variants when `multi_query` is on. |
| `rrf_k` | `int` | `60` | Reciprocal Rank Fusion smoothing constant. |
| `final_top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Alias for `final_top_k`; `final_top_k` wins when both are set. |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |
| `bm25_top_k` | `int` | `20` | BM25 candidates per query (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `vector_top_k` | `int` | `20` | Vector candidates per query (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `bm25_weight` | `float` | `1.0` | Weight of the BM25 ranking in weighted RRF; raise it to favor lexical evidence. |
| `vector_weight` | `float` | `1.0` | Weight of the vector ranking in weighted RRF; raise it to favor semantic evidence. |
| `candidate_top_k` | `int` | `30` | Fused candidates handed to the reranker (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `reranker` | `str` | `local_relevance` | `simple_keyword_overlap`, `local_relevance` (TF-IDF), or `llm`. |

## `parent_doc`

**Parent document.** Retrieve small child chunks, answer from their larger parent chunks.

Best for: Better answer context with precise retrieval. Cost: low; latency: fast.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |
| `top_k_children` | `int` | `8` | Child chunks searched (raised to twice the parent depth if smaller). |
| `top_k_parents` | `int` | `4` | Parent chunks returned; also how many the generator reads. |
| `parent_score_aggregation` | `max` \| `sum` \| `mean` | `max` | How child scores roll up to their parent: `max` keeps the best match, `sum` rewards parents hit by several children, `mean` averages. |

`chunker:` options (replaces the shared chunker section)

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parent_chunk_size` | `int` | `1000` | Parent chunk size in words. |
| `parent_chunk_overlap` | `int` | `150` | Overlap between parent chunks in words. |
| `child_chunk_size` | `int` | `250` | Child chunk size in words. |
| `child_chunk_overlap` | `int` | `50` | Overlap between child chunks in words. |

## `rerank`

**Vector + rerank.** Vector retrieval followed by a reranking pass.

Best for: Higher precision context selection. Cost: low; latency: fast.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multi_query` | `bool` | `false` | Retrieve with local (non-LLM) query variants to help multi-hop questions. |
| `max_query_variants` | `int` | `4` | Maximum number of query variants when `multi_query` is on. |
| `final_top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Alias for `final_top_k`; `final_top_k` wins when both are set. |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |
| `candidate_top_k` | `int` | `30` | Vector candidates handed to the reranker (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `reranker` | `str` | `simple_keyword_overlap` | `simple_keyword_overlap`, `local_relevance` (TF-IDF), or `llm`. |

## `vector`

**Vector.** Embedding search with cosine similarity (Chroma-backed, exact in-memory fallback).

Best for: Semantic baseline. Cost: low; latency: fast.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |

## `hyde`

**HyDE.** Hypothetical Document Embeddings: the LLM writes a hypothetical answer used as the search probe.

Best for: Short or vaguely-worded questions. Cost: medium; latency: medium.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rrf_k` | `int` | `60` | Reciprocal Rank Fusion smoothing constant. |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |
| `probe_top_k` | `int` | unset | Results fetched per ranking before fusion. Default: twice the retrieval depth, at least 10. |
| `fuse_with_question` | `bool` | `true` | Fuse the hypothetical-document ranking with the raw-question ranking via RRF. |

## `llm_heavy`

**LLM-heavy.** LLM-driven ingestion metadata, query rewriting, and reranking.

Best for: Higher-cost, quality-oriented experiments. Cost: high; latency: slow.

`retrieval:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `top_k` | `int` | unset | Chunks given to the generator. Default 5; when unset the evaluator uses `evaluation.context_k`. |
| `vector_store` | `chroma` \| `in_memory` | `chroma` | Vector backend. `chroma` falls back to exact in-memory search if Chroma cannot be used. |
| `persist_directory` | `str` | unset | Directory for a persistent Chroma store (default: ephemeral). |
| `per_query_top_k` | `int` | `10` | Candidates per rewritten query (raised to the retrieval depth if smaller). |
| `reranker` | `str` | `simple_keyword_overlap` | Reranker used when `llm_features.enable_llm_rerank` is off. |

`llm_features:` options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enable_llm_ingestion` | `bool` | `false` | Enrich every chunk at ingestion with an LLM summary, entities, and hypothetical questions. |
| `enable_query_rewrite` | `bool` | `true` | Rewrite each question into several search queries with the LLM. |
| `enable_llm_rerank` | `bool` | `false` | Rerank candidates with an LLM call. |
